test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Our family is planning / a trip to Europe next summer / where we should visit several famous / landmarks and enjoy local cuisine.

options.text: where we should visit several famous
a trip to Europe next summer

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of "**should**" instead of "**will**."
 
• In this context, "**should**" suggests obligation or recommendation, but the intended meaning is to describe future plans.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**where we will visit several famous**," ensuring grammatical **correctness and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Our family is planning a trip to Europe next summer**, where we will visit **several famous landmarks and enjoy local cuisine."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Our family is planning," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "a trip to Europe next summer"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "landmarks and enjoy local cuisine."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
